sections.excerpt:
Risk Factors Investing in the notes involves risk. You should read the “Risk Factors” section of this prospectus supplement and in our latest Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, and other periodic reports we
have filed and may file with the SEC from time to time, for a discussion of factors to which you should refer and carefully consider prior to making an investment in the notes. Trading The notes are new issues of securities with no established trading markets. We intend to apply to list each series of the notes on Nasdaq. The listing application will be subject to approval by Nasdaq. We currently expect trading in each series
